text: {"lessons":["The account has fallen from its period-5 high, reminding me that even modest monthly declines can accumulate; I should prioritize protecting savings I rely on for living expenses.","Selling Stock E at a large loss was difficult, but I should assess each holding on its current prospects and risk—not cling to it or sell solely because of its past cost.","I have traded infrequently, and that suits me; I should keep decisions deliberate, avoid reacting to short-term price moves, and maintain a balanced portfolio."]}
